description: Intrusion-detection events: data source 2. Several providers may be active at once; every event names the provider that reported it, and the kind keeps a watermark per file.

cadences.basis: Survey, data source 2, "Sustainable polling frequency": alerts are low-volume and the backend re-reads the file backwards from the end on every call, so polling more often costs without benefit.

page_size.basis: 500 is the figure the collectors carried as a constant before the page became a setting, and nothing more: a documented starting point, not a measurement and not a survey figure. What an installation needs depends on how fast its sources write, which only that installation can measure: the collection surface measures it and suggests a pair. The default is within what the firewall serves for this read, so a database with no row never asks for a page the firewall would cut short.

sizing.basis: The alert query's `rowCount` defaults to 9999: a page this size is far beyond what an alert feed produces per poll.

functions.description: Called at every probe round: asks the firewall whether this implementation can be read and whether its configuration serves clients.

functions.description: Called before every read: which of the feed's files still exist, so a lost file is recorded as a permanent gap.

functions.description: Called at every security-event pass: the newest page_size events, newest first.
